full_judgment: 5. We have heard the learned Advocate who pointed out that the 2 witnesses who allegedly had witnessed the recovery were Haroon and Shamsul Huq. P.W. 2 Haroon was not examined and no explanation was given for his non-examination. Therefore, presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act will be available. As for P.W. 2 Shamsul Huq it is clear that he did not see the recovery of incriminating articles. The other witness Sontosh, he signed the seizure list in the thana. Therefore it is not proved that these incriminating articles were recovered from Nur Hossain. Suggestion is given that Nur Hossain was inimical with the police and out of that grudge lie was falsely implicated. It is in evidence of P.W. 1 that Sarikal was a big hat and it was a hat day his curious that no other witness was examined nor any person witnessed the recovery of the incriminating articles. This defect raises a question of doubt in the prosecution and benefit of this defect would go to the appellant. P.W. I stated that incriminating articles were recovered in presence of Son tosh Kumar and Shamsul Huq but they did not witness the recovery of incriminating articles.
